note: Everything the macOS setup downloads besides the Python packages. Python and the person detector are pinned by checksum; FFmpeg takes the publisher's current build (see ffmpeg.note). The Python packages are pinned, with their checksums, in requirements-mac-arm64.txt and requirements-mac-intel.txt.

arm64.note: Apple Silicon wheels include the Metal backend. PyTorch 2.7.1, from the lock file.

x86_64.note: PyTorch stopped building Intel macOS wheels after 2.2, so Intel Macs use 2.2.2 on the processor. The shipped models give identical answers on 2.2.2 and 2.7.1; this was checked before release.

ffmpeg.note: Static builds from osxexperts.net, which replaces these files in place when FFmpeg updates. They are not pinned by checksum: setup accepts any copy that runs and reports FFmpeg 7 or newer (the minimum is in setup.sh).

people.note: Person detector weights. The ultralytics library itself is in the lock files. Ultralytics is AGPL-3.0.
